answer: One concrete mechanism is a progressive vault-lock system where each new agent identity must spiral its required stake upward based on recent registrations, bonded to a physical quartz crystal oscillator for timing attestation. An attacker creating sybils must source and bind unique quartz hardware for every fake identity, costing hundreds of dollars per agent in specialized components that cannot be cloned in software, making mass sybil attacks economically prohibitive as the spiral escalates rapidly.
